Icm.//TrustedUserName: The ICM user calls act as, sent as the X-ICM-TrustedUserName header. Set it with: dotnet user-secrets set "Icm:TrustedUserName" 'the-username'

Auth.//TokenUrl: Optional. Set only for a non-Keycloak server or an unusual path; it overrides BaseUrl and Realm entirely.

//Mode: query = the Service Request search below. buspass = submit the BusPass section through the INT-316 workflow, then read the created SR back (a hand-run integration test - it CREATES a record in the target ICM). contact = search contacts by id, name, SIN, PHN, birth date etc. (read-only). case = read a case by row id or find it by case number / key player, and print it with the people on it (read-only). describe = fetch a resource's OpenAPI document from ICM and save it (read-only).

Contact.//: The search for contact mode. Every criterion identifies a person, so none is committed: pass them on the command line (--Contact:LastName=... --Contact:BirthDate=1950-01-31) or keep them in the user-secret store. Criteria: Id, PersonId, IntegrationId, BcServicesCardDid (quote it - base64 may contain + / =), Sin (nine digits), Phn, FirstName, MiddleName, LastName, BirthDate (yyyy-MM-dd), Email, CellPhone, HomePhone, WorkPhone, MessagePhone. All that are set must match.
Contact.//NameMatch: How the name criteria are compared, always ignoring case: Exact, StartsWith or Contains.
Contact.//ViewMode: Siebel visibility. MEASURED on SIT1 2026-09-17: the default already sees contacts, unlike service requests. Try Organization if a known contact is not found.
Contact.//ShowValues: false reports which fields came back filled, not what they hold - enough to check the search and mapping without people's details in scrollback.

Case.//: case mode. Id reads one case by its row id (the case_key); otherwise the criteria below are searched, ANDed. The three key-player criteria take what a contact search prints: ContactId its Id, PersonId its PersonId, IntegrationId its IntegrationId. Pass them on the command line, e.g. --Case:CaseNumber=1-11077140770.
Case.//ViewMode: Null is the library's default, Manager. MEASURED on SIT2 2026-09-24: Sales Rep (ICM's default), Organization and Personal hide the reference case; Manager, Group, Sub-Organization and Catalog see it.
Case.//ShowValues: SIT1 and SIT2 hold test data, so values print by default. Set false against anything else.

Describe.//Resource: The two path segments after data/, e.g. ICMContact/ICMContact or ServiceRequest/ServiceRequest.
Describe.//OutputFile: Where to write the document, e.g. ../IcmApi/docs/integration/Contact_OpenApi.json. Null prints it instead.

BusPass.//: Synthetic on purpose: the SIN is the canonical test number, the address is the BC legislature. A buspass run creates a real SR in the target ICM.

Mailing.//: Leave empty for a One Address submission; fill in for Multiple Addresses.

Query.//ServiceRequestKey: An ICM row id to read on its own after the search. This is the Row # from Siebel's About Record dialog, not the SR # in the list - the SR # is not a queryable field on this business component. Null skips the step.
Query.//SearchSpec: e.g. [Status] = "Open". Note [SR Number] does NOT work - ICM rejects it as an invalid field.
Query.//Fields: ICM's live field names. The committed default deliberately selects non-personal fields only - SIT records carry real-looking names, addresses and phone numbers, and 'full' output would put them in terminal scrollback. Set to [] to request every field when a run genuinely needs it (e.g. hunting unmodelled fields with --Output=raw).
Query.//ChildLinks: Child business components to link in the response.
Query.//ChildCollection: A child business component to read raw after the read-by-key step, e.g. SRProspects (the applicant rows a Bus Pass SR carries). Null skips it.
Query.//ViewMode: Siebel visibility. ICM's default, 'Sales Rep', returns only records the trusted user owns - which hides most of the data. MEASURED: 'Sales Rep' and 'Manager' cannot see SR 1-53A894E; 'Organization' can. 'All' is rejected outright (SBL-EAI-50243).
Query.//ExcludeEmptyFields: true keeps the dump readable; set false to see every field ICM defines.

//Output: full = every non-null mapped field per record. summary = one line each. raw = the untouched JSON ICM returned, then the mapped view - use this to see fields the model does not cover.
